title: David and Goliath
subtitle: The story of a shepherd boy, a giant, and a God who is bigger than both

scenes.title: The Shepherd Boy
beats: Long ago in Bethlehem lived a boy named David. He was the youngest in his family, and his job was to take care of his father’s sheep.
Out in the hills, David played his harp and sang songs to God. And when a lion or a bear came to snatch a lamb, God helped David save it!
God looked at David’s heart, and He loved what He saw. God chose David to be king of Israel one day.

scenes.title: A Giant Named Goliath
beats: One day, God’s people went to war against the Philistines. The two armies camped on two hills, with a valley in between.
Out of the Philistine camp stomped a giant named Goliath. He was taller than two grown-ups! His armor was shiny bronze, and his spear was as big as a tree.
“Send someone to fight me!” Goliath roared. Every day he shouted, and every day the soldiers of Israel shook with fear.

scenes.title: Too Big!
beats: David came to bring food to his big brothers, and he heard the giant shouting. “I’ll fight him!” said David. “God saved me from the lion and the bear. He will save me from this giant too!”
So King Saul gave David his own armor. But it was much too big! The helmet wobbled, the armor clanked, and David could hardly walk.
“I can’t walk in these,” David laughed. So he took them off. David didn’t need armor. He had God!

layers.hint: Tap to take off the armor

scenes.title: Five Smooth Stones
beats: David went down to a little stream. He picked out five smooth stones and put them in his shepherd’s bag.
When Goliath saw a boy coming, he laughed. But David called out, “You come with a sword and a spear. But I come in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel!”

scenes.title: The Giant Falls
beats: Goliath stomped closer. David ran toward him! He put a stone in his sling, swung it round and round, and let it fly.
Whizz! The stone hit Goliath right on the forehead. The giant wobbled and toppled, and down he fell with a great big CRASH!
All of Israel cheered! With just a sling and a stone, God won the battle. “The battle belongs to the Lord!”

questions: Everyone else was afraid of the giant. Why wasn’t David afraid?
What is something that feels as big as a giant to you?
David said God would help him. How can God help you be brave?
